Issue: Circuit connected to panel has zero load
Recommended Action: Verify connected loads. If intentional, mark as Spare/Space or remove unused circuit.
Revise breaker to nearest valid standard size or confirm special condition.

Issue: Circuit rating is below apparent current
Recommended Action: Upsize breaker or reduce connected load.

Issue: Non-zero load is not connected to an electrical system
Limit/Target: Device should be assigned to a circuit

Issue: Non-zero load circuit is not assigned to a panel
Recommended Action: Assign the circuit to the correct panel.
Add Transformer Rating_CED to family/type or verify this is not a standard transformer family.

Issue: Transformer demand exceeds transformer kVA rating
Recommended Action: Upsize transformer or reduce downstream demand.

Issue: Transformer primary demand current is near upstream breaker rating
Recommended Action: Review upstream breaker/loading. Upsize or confirm acceptable loading.

Issue: Transformer rated primary current is near upstream breaker rating
Transformer secondary circuit length exceeds 25 ft
Recommended Action: Verify remote secondary overcurrent device is within 25 ft.

Issue: Main breaker rating exceeds equipment mains rating
Recommended Action: Correct equipment mains or MCB rating.

Issue: Upstream breaker exceeds downstream equipment mains rating
Recommended Action: Review feeder OCP and downstream equipment rating.

Issue: Upstream breaker exceeds downstream MCB rating
Recommended Action: Review feeder OCP coordination or correct MCB rating.

Issue: Downstream MCB exceeds upstream breaker rating
Limit/Target: MCB <= upstream breaker unless intentionally coordinated
Recommended Action: Review MCB and feeder breaker sizing.
Review whether open slots should be left open, filled with spaces, or reserved.

Issue: Panel appears to supply equipment with larger rating than source panel
Observed: 100 A source panel / 225 A supplied panel
Limit/Target: Supplied equipment rating <= source panel rating
Recommended Action: Verify source panel rating, feeder, and downstream equipment data.
